edits.before: This proposal presents the revised algorithmic design of the Oak Sports Academy Training Registration and Management System based on the clarified client workflow. It replaces the previous preference-weighted schedule recommendation algorithm because the revised workflow allows students to select available schedules but does not establish a schedule recommendation feature.
edits.after: This proposal presents the algorithmic design of the Oak Sports Academy Training Registration and Management System. The system supports participant registration, free-trial assessment, enrollment, attendance monitoring, training-package management, and digital document collection. The proposed algorithms maintain consistent participant records, support explainable participation-risk classification, and validate uploaded image documents.
